title: Undirected cube boundary fraction
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube with values in $\{\pm1\}$. The undirected cube boundary fraction of $f$ is the probability that a uniformly chosen undirected cube edge has endpoints on which $f$ takes different values.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
